subject: Genetics
title: The Future of Prediction
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Future of Prediction.

hook.text: Could we predict a child's traits from a DNA sample at birth? Disease risk, height, personality? Maybe. Should we?

buildup.text: Polygenic scores are improving. Large biobanks with millions of genomes make predictions more accurate each year.

discovery.text: Embryo selection already happens. Some IVF clinics offer polygenic screening to choose embryos with lower disease risk.

climax.text: The ethical questions outpace the science.

punchline.text: We can read the odds. We can't read the future.

quiz.question: Why is predicting complex traits from DNA still imprecise?
options: Complex traits involve many genes plus environment
